name: Feature request
about: Suggest a capability, API addition, or integration
title: ''
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Use case

What are you trying to accomplish, and what does a typical workflow
look like? Concrete examples land better than abstract requirements.

## Proposed API

A sketch of what the user-facing API might look like. Even a rough
draft helps anchor the discussion:

```julia
using Arborist
# ... hypothetical code ...
```

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you evaluated, and why they fall short. "I searched
the docs and didn't find anything equivalent" is a fine starting point.

## Related references

Papers, prior implementations (e.g. `neat-python`, `SymbolicRegression.jl`,
`ECJ`, `DEAP`), blog posts, benchmark results — anything that gives
context on how this is typically approached elsewhere.

## Willingness to contribute

- [ ] I'd like to implement this myself and would appreciate guidance
  on where it should live.
- [ ] I'd like someone else to implement this.
- [ ] I'm not sure yet — looking for design feedback first.
